R301.note: Allowlist correctly validates filters.table before interpolation; bound params for accountId/status unchanged.

R303.note: setSecure(true) closes the finding cleanly; HttpOnly preserved, log message truthfully updated to match.

R304.note: StackExchange.Redis StringSet frames args via RESP so CRLF/space can't forge a second command; SendSetCommand signature unchanged so callers are unaffected.

R305.note: expr-eval removes all code-execution surface from formula evaluation; scope narrowed to total/tax matches the only fields the real caller supplies.

R306.note: resolve_entities=False is lxml's documented XXE fix; no unrelated changes.

R310.note: Explicit allowlist of column identifiers, correctly kept separate from the parameterized value bindings.

R311.note: Hand-rolled RFC4515 escaping covers the metacharacters relevant to a filter-value position.

R312.note: crypto/rand replaces math/rand with adequate entropy and a checked error path; username portion of the session id unchanged.

R313.note: Storing an owned std::string in the cache removes the dangling view; no functional change to callers.

R315.note: at() supplies exactly the bounds guarantee the original code was missing; only invalid indices are affected, which were never legitimate.

R316.note: Control-character stripping plus lazy %s formatting neutralizes CRLF log injection; truncation only affects the log record, not the HTTP response.

R317.note: JSON.parse has no code-revival facility; try/catch and a shape check preserve the existing req.profile contract for well-formed input.

R321.note: Switching to System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping removes the shell entirely; output text format differs but the ping functionality (4 probes against the given host) is preserved for legitimate input.

R324.note: Plain JSX interpolation replaces dangerouslySetInnerHTML; encoding is automatic and the visible ticket content is unchanged.

R326.note: th:text is Thymeleaf's own escaping attribute; a one-line change with no other effect on the surrounding code.

R327.note: Dispatch is restricted to a fixed CHAT_COMMANDS map; no attacker-controlled string ever reaches call_user_func_array.

R328.note: Content-sniffed MIME/type verification and randomized filenames correctly remove the dangerous-extension vector, but the added 5MB cap is unrelated to CWE-434 and can reject legitimate larger avatars that previously succeeded — disclosed, not silent, so 1 rather than 2.

R330.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) matches the intended 'no reservation yet == 0' semantics with no change for SKUs that already have entries.
